description: tools/test-projects/navigation, a Release build (BUILD_TYPE=Release WEB_PROJECT=navigation tools/build.sh web, gated with GATE=navigation; WEB_THREADS=1 for both steps gives the pthreads build): a reduced bench_nav_city and nav_2d_topdown baked at runtime. Single-threaded, the tiles are time-sliced on the main thread and the longest slice is printed with the web bake budget + 2 ms (R23, release budgets; over it is a warning: CI's browser renders in software and a loaded host preempts the page, and wall-clock budgets are reported, never asserted); both builds log the same navmesh hashes (byte-identical bakes, AC20); a grid path is found, an agent walks the city and arrives, and a carving box closes a walled gap and opens it again (S74 AC21). No pixel check.
